summary: Bundled SDK with POST calls and 'dyndns' string; behavior not verified
details: The package ships a minified bundle (dist/index.js) that contains multiple POST call sites and a 'dyndns' substring. The POST patterns matched on keyword co-occurrence in a rolled-up bundle, which is the normal shape of any SDK that talks to an HTTP API; no specific installer-side data read is tied to a specific non-first-party destination, and no install-time lifecycle script or top-level side effect has been shown to execute the flagged code paths. The 'dyndns' hit is a single-token substring match without traced binding to a network call. Without a named installer secret flowing to a named attacker host, the evidence does not confirm exfiltration, dropper, silent-relay, credential-distribution, or backdoor behavior.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
